insights.one_liner: A Hoofddorp cybersecurity company protecting video, games and connected cars, owned by CANAL+, that offers visa support and international internships.

culture.text: Staff mostly work in engineering and IT, from schools like UvA, VU and several Indian universities.
It has 650+ employees in 10 locations and serves 400+ clients in more than 75 countries.
Its internship programme lets students in EMEA and APAC work on real projects with global teams and mentors.

open.text: Irdeto B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
It says it helps with visa or work authorisation where applicable.
Both current Hoofddorp internships are open to non-Dutch speakers.

worth_knowing.text: CANAL+ CTO Stéphane Baumier was named chairman of Irdeto's supervisory board.
A game-cracking group reportedly disbanded after a lawsuit from Irdeto over its Denuvo anti-piracy tech.
Its ultimate owner is Bolloré Participations SE of France.
